summary: Reviewed src/App.tsx, src/data/portfolio.ts, src/components/EditorialTemplate.tsx, and src/components/DocModal.tsx. Section 06 (Official Dossier & Resume) renders portfolioData.documents and invokes onOpenDoc(doc.id), which opens DocModal to validate env.filePassword via checkPassword before triggering an anchor download for doc.filePath (relative to public/, so public/docs/학위증명서.pdf resolves at docs/학위증명서.pdf) with doc.filename ('학위증명서.pdf').
